SuperPage.Title: Application settings
SuperPage.Subtitle: Manage logging settings in appSettings.json
SuperPage.ConfigurationHint: You are editing the configuration in the running application directory, not the source project copy. Restart the application after saving to apply changes.
SuperPage.ProviderHint: Both providers share the settings below.
SuperPage.MinimumLevelHint: Success messages are filtered at the Info level.
SuperPage.LogDirectoryHint: Use an absolute path or a path relative to the application directory. Logs are grouped by date, for example Logs/2026-10-07/log.log.
SuperPage.FileSizeLimitHint: Default: 10485760 bytes (10 MiB). A new file is created when the limit is reached.
SuperPage.RetainedFileCountHint: Serilog includes the current file; NLog counts archives plus a separate current file. This is not a retention period in days and does not remove older date folders.
SuperPage.RestoreDefaultsHint: Reset the form only; save to write the changes to the file
SuperPage.ReloadHint: Discard unsaved form changes and reload the file
SuperPage.RootObjectRequired: The configuration root must be a JSON object.
SuperPage.LoggingObjectRequired: The Logging section must be a JSON object.
SuperPage.FileMissing: The configuration file does not exist. Defaults are loaded; save to create the file.
SuperPage.Loaded: Configuration loaded. Restart the application after saving to apply changes.
SuperPage.ReadFailed: Could not load configuration: {0} Fix the file and reload. The original file will not be overwritten.
SuperPage.DefaultsRestored: Defaults restored in the form. Changes have not been saved.
SuperPage.DefaultsRequireReload: Defaults restored in the form. Fix the configuration file and reload before saving.
SuperPage.InvalidSelection: Select a valid logging provider and minimum log level.
SuperPage.LogDirectoryRequired: The log directory cannot be empty.
SuperPage.FileSizeInvalid: The file size must be a positive integer in bytes.
SuperPage.FileCountInvalid: The retained file count must be a positive integer.
SuperPage.ExternalChange: The configuration file has changed externally. Reload before saving to avoid overwriting other changes.
SuperPage.Saved: Configuration saved. Restart the application to apply changes. If a file already existed, its previous version is saved in appSettings.json.bak.
SuperPage.SavedReloadFailed: Configuration was saved, but the file could not be reloaded: {0} Reload before editing again. Restart the application to apply the saved settings.
SuperPage.ConsoleHint: Open a console even when running the EXE outside the IDE to view live DebuggerLogger output. No save or restart is needed; earlier messages are not replayed. Close it using the button below without exiting the application or stopping file logging. The native console close button is disabled; redirected IDE output is preserved.
SuperPage.ConsoleClosed: Application console is closed (redirected IDE output is unaffected)
SuperPage.ConsoleOpened: Debug console opened. Receiving DebuggerLogger output.
